adaptive_enamel_arch.findings: Dental arch constructed strictly along real MIP enamel density peaks (1516 HU mean). Both posterior branches along molars 44..48 and 34..38 run strictly posteriorly parallel to the sagittal midline along the occlusal fissures and distal molars (48, 38). Zero lateral flare into the cheeks.

soft_natural_radiographic_contrast.findings: OPG reconstructed with W: 2000, L: 450 HU, unsharpAlpha: 0.18. Zero white burnouts, zero over-sharpening halos. Subtle crisp trabecular bone and enamel crowns. Widescreen panoramic display across full card width.

honest_physical_cross_sections.findings: Windows 3..8 show real transverse cross-sections through teeth 46, 36, 11, 26, 27 (Zakharov) + 46 (Bulyakov) using real 16-bit HU trilinear voxels. Exact calipers (W2, W6, H) and anatomical limits (Cavum Nasi, Sinus Maxillaris, Mandibular canal). 11, 26, 27 accurately report W6 = 0.0 mm (air) with explicit surgical alerts.
